name: plm-service-fullstack
description: PLM Service Prototype - Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:shared
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:frontend -- --fix && npm run lint:backend -- --fix
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules shared/node_modules frontend/dist backend/dist shared/dist

author: PLM Development Team
